name: dsh-liang-guard
description: 梁神卫士 (Liang Guard) — a system-guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web UI: one-click health check, real Windows Defender scans, network speed test & repair, live system metrics with memory release. Injects a guarded button under the sidebar's New Session button; all APIs ride the DSH webserver's same-origin route.
